The '''221st Mechanized Assault Group''' was a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The unit fielded [[Color/Legends|light blue]] [[TIE crawler/Legends|century tanks]] with augmented defenses and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] modifications.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
A 221st Mechanized century tank miniature labeled as a "TIE Crawler"&mdash;another name for the century tank&mdash;was featured in the ''[[Ground Assault]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'',<ref name="SWPM" /> released in [[2007]].<ref name="year">{{WizKids|url=StarWars/newsandextras/newstemplate.aspx?id=4044|text=GROUND ASSAULT AVAILABLE IN STORES NOW!}}</ref> The miniature's base stand was printed with an an attack value of zero, representing that it had nothing to increase its chance to hit a target. Its defensive values, however, were higher than those printed on most other units of its kind.<ref name="SWPM" />
